_provenance.note: Hawaii citation authorities. Hawaii's operative SNAP policy manual is Title 17 of the Hawaii Administrative Rules (HAR), cited by a bare numbered-section convention such as '17-676-73' (Title 17, Chapter 676, section 73). This pack also cites a real Hawaii Revised Statute, Haw. Rev. Stat. § 346-53.3, for the drug-felony finding, so this pack defines a SECOND citation family, 'hrs346', matching this roster's Nebraska, Connecticut, Kentucky, Alabama, and Louisiana packs' multi-family pattern.

patterns.note: Hawaii Administrative Rules, Title 17 (Department of Human Services), cited by bare chapter-section number, e.g. 17-676-73 (Standard Utility Allowance), 17-663-82 (Intentional Program Violation / Felony Drug Conviction / Fleeing Felon), 17-663-82.1 (SSN Disqualification and ABAWD).
Hawaii Revised Statutes, Chapter 346 (Department of Human Services), cited by section number. This pack cites exactly one: Haw. Rev. Stat. § 346-53.3, the drug-felony modified-ban statute.

har17.note: Standard Utility Allowance — establishes INDIVIDUAL per-utility-type standard allowances (sewer/trash, water, electricity/gas, mandatory telephone), each separately weighted by county SNAP caseload share and, for water/electricity/gas, by household size and (electricity/gas only) bedroom count. Optional, not mandatory — households may switch between actual costs and the standard allowances at each recertification and one additional time per 12-month certification period.

Intentional program violation, felony drug conviction, fleeing felon disqualification, and work requirement sanction — governs how the eligibility/benefit level of REMAINING household members is calculated when one member is disqualified for one of these reasons; the disqualified member's income/resources continue to count, but the disqualified member is excluded from household-size calculations.

SSN disqualification and ineligible able-bodied adults without dependents (ABAWD) — parallel proration rules for a household containing a member disqualified for refusing/failing to provide an SSN or for exceeding the ABAWD time limit under 17-684-39.
Ineligible aliens — parallel proration rules for a household containing an ineligible noncitizen member.

hrs346.note: SNAP/TANF eligibility for individuals with a felony conviction involving possession, use, or distribution of a controlled substance — CONDITIONAL modified ban: the federal ban (21 U.S.C. § 862a(a)(2) / Section 115(a) of P.L. 104-193) does not apply in Hawaii to persons complying with treatment, or who have not refused or failed to comply with treatment. This pack's exact-text confirmation rests on WebSearch/Justia-excerpt corroboration, not a directly-fetched primary document — both law.justia.com and capitol.hawaii.gov returned HTTP 403 to every direct-fetch attempt this pack made.
